title: Global Fiber Optic Propagation
description: You are managing a global network of servers. You are given a list of directed transmission links, where each link takes a specific time to propagate a signal from a source server to a target server. Given a starting server index, determine the minimum time it takes for a signal to reach all reachable servers in the network. If it is impossible for the signal to reach every server, return -1.
constraints: All server pairs (source, target) are unique
input_format: A list of directed links [u, v, w] representing transmission time w from u to v, the total number of servers n, and the starting server k.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum time for all servers to receive the signal, or -1 if unreachable.

examples.explanation: From server 2, it takes 1 unit of time to reach server 1 and 3, and 2 units of time to reach server 4 via server 3.
Signal propagates from server 1 to 2 in 1 unit of time.
Starting at server 2, server 1 is never reached.
